get.summary: Find cross-venue perpetual-futures funding-rate arbitrage
get.description: Cross-venue perpetual-futures funding-rate arbitrage scan across BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP, annualising each venue's rate on its own confirmed interval and ranking spreads into a market-neutral long/short pairing per asset. Checks Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, dYdX v4, Coinbase and Deribit; Binance and Bybit are not reachable from this deployment's own host region and are withheld whenever a current, fresh reading isn't available. Ranking an asset needs at least two reachable venues. This route auto-pauses (HTTP 503, no charge) whenever every asset drops below that, re-enabling once coverage recovers -- see /v1/service-health for live status. Purpose: Rank funding-rate arbitrage opportunities across tracked assets and venues as a comparability signal, never a guaranteed-profit claim. 5-minute freshness target; missing evidence is reported explicitly rather than invented.
